name: long-diagonal
title: Long diagonal
description: Issue #448: one long straight drive up RED's half of the BIOBUZZ field, west of the hive, starting with the heading 90 degrees off the direction of travel and ending on a field axis. A Linear heading strafes the whole way; turning onto the path, driving nose first and turning back is the plan the issue asks Optimize path to find.

pose.provenance: SET BY HAND: issue #448 fixture, in RED's south-west corner, the tilted frame 1.3 in clear of the west wall, facing 90 degrees right of the drive to (-36, 56)

from.provenance: SET BY HAND: issue #448 fixture, the start pose

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: issue #448 fixture, in RED's half north-west of the hive, 116.5 in from the start, facing east along the field's x axis

steps.notes: The drive is 78.1 degrees from the x axis, so the robot starts 90 degrees off it and strafes nearly all the way.
